summary: Build NGO sourcing assessments, supplier risk records and follow-up plans. Explore the course and enquire about enrolment.
lede: Sustainable supply chain training helps NGO procurement and programme teams assess sourcing risks and document purchasing decisions. Participants practise supplier spend and risk analysis, responsible sourcing criteria, due diligence records, scorecards and corrective-action tracking. They also consider environmental and human-rights risks, supplier evidence and proportionate next steps for procurement review.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for NGO professionals who make, document or oversee purchasing decisions and supplier relationships. It suits people who need practical tools for responsible sourcing under programme, budget and supplier-data constraints.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with purchasing, supplier coordination or programme delivery is recommended. No coding or specialist software setup is required.
